sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Ashby Ivanhoe in the Isuzu FA Vase First Qualifying Round this Saturday at 3pm, looking to bounce back after a difficult midweek. The Bach suffered a 3-1 defeat to New Mills on Tuesday, conceding an awkward bounce goal late on despite a spirited second-half performance. Manager JKD will be calling on supporters to get behind the team in good voice as they face higher-level opposition in cup competition.
divisionWide: The top of the table remains competitive with Wolverhampton Casuals, Eccleshall, and Stafford Town all on 9 points, though Casuals' unbeaten run ended with a 2-1 midweek defeat to Eccleshall. New Mills stay joint-top after thrashing Sandbach 3-1 and now face Northwich Victoria in the FA Vase. AFC Bridgnorth remain unbeaten in the league despite drawing 1-1 with Wednesfield midweek and entertain Crewe this Saturday. Shawbury United grabbed a dramatic 4-3 away win at Allscott Heath in an entertaining encounter. Several clubs enter cup action this weekend: Stafford Town host Abbey Hulton United in their 50th anniversary celebrations, Eccleshall face Allscott Heath, New Mills take on Northwich Victoria, Telford Town welcome Darlaston Town, and Foley Meir host Redditch Borough. Market Drayton Town travel to Studley FC after a strong 3-0 win over Crewe last weekend. Crewe, Bilston Town, and Widnes Town continue to struggle near the bottom of the table.
